paragraphs: TimeKeep is a cross-platform stopwatch and session tracker designed for students, professionals, and productivity enthusiasts. Track, name, and review your focused sessions with rich statistics, dark/light mode, and persistent storage. Perfect for studying, workouts, work sprints, or daily routines.
features: High-precision stopwatch (millisecond accuracy) — pause, resume, and save sessions.
Named sessions — label your focused work (e.g., "Physics Study", "Jogging").
Persistent session storage — browser/local storage + Capacitor Preferences.
Monthly calendar view — review activity chronologically, colored indicators for active days.
Detailed statistics — total session time, daily/weekly breakdowns, per-session insights.
